EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority)PART IV (B) — LOCAL GOVERNMENT
Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE
Notice under Section 10A(1)(a)
MINIPE PRADESHIYA SABHA

I, Mudiyanselage Kumudu Saman Sri Rathnayaka, Returning Officer of the Minipe Pradeshiya Sabha, do hereby declareunder Section 10A(1)(a) of the (Chapter 262) Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, that Mr. Bandaranayake MudiyanselageShantha Sisira Kumara Bandaranayake of the Minipe Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of that PradeshiyaSabha as he has ceased to be a member of the United National Party.
SAMAN SRI RATHNAYAKE,
Returning Officer,District Elections Office, Minipe Pradeshiya Sabha.Kandy,20th March, 2015.

FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE MEMBER OF THE
VAVUNIYA SOUTH SINHALA PRADESHIYA SABHA
UNDER SECTION 65A (2) OF THELOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE
(CHAPTER 262) AS AMENDED BYLOCAL AUTHORITIES (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 30 OF 2013
WHEREAS, the office of a member in Vavuniya South Sinhala Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Death ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the recognized political party namely United People's Freedom Alliance, towhich the Former member Gunathilage Ariyawansa belonged was required by me under Section 65A(2) of the aforesaidOrdinance, to nominate within a period of thirty (30) days a person eligible under the Ordinance for Election as a member ofthat Vavuniya South Sinhala Pradeshiya Sabha who shall be declared as a member ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has nominated Mr. Gunapalage SarathMadu being an eligible person under the aforesaid Ordinance to fill such vacancy :

NOW THEREFORE I, Abdul offoor Muhammad Nafeel, Returning Officer of Vavuniya South Sinhala PradeshiyaSabha, acting in terms of Section 65A(2) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance as amended by filling of vacancies inLocal Authorities (Special Provisions) Act, No. 30 of 2013 (Chapter 262) do hereby declare Mr. Gunapalage Sarath Maduelected as a member of the Vavuniya South Sinhala Pradeshiya Sabha.
A. O. M. NAFEEL,Returning Officer,Vavuniya South Sinhala Pradeshiya Sabha.
District Elections Office,Vavuniya,20th March 2015.
Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE
Notice under Section 10A(1)(a)
KURUNEGALA PRADESHIYA SABHA

I, Thalangama Appuhamilage Chaminda Namal Thalangama, Returning Officer of the Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha, dohereby declare under Section 10A(1)(a) of the (Chapter 262) Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, that Mr. MohottalalageThilina Dhanushka Ekanayake of the Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of the member of that PradeshiyaSabha as he has ceased to be a member of the United National Party.
T. A. C. N. THALANGAMA,
Returning Officer,District Elections Office,Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha.Kurunegala,20th March, 2015.
